purpose: Freeze the accepted engineering state before real clinical-accuracy evaluation begins.

required_jobs: Bounded JPEG/PDF decoder and canonical intake

evaluation_domains: image digitization error against paired digital waveforms
lead identity and calibration correctness on real ECG images
end-to-end interpretation agreement only after lower layers are quantified
mandatory_evaluation_controls: Evaluate a frozen target commit/tree and record it with every result.
Use immutable dataset manifests with source, license, version, and record hashes.
Use patient-level separation where applicable; no train/development/test patient leakage.
Predefine label mapping, exclusions, abstention handling, and metrics before inspecting final test results.
Keep source labels, adjudicated project gold, and model predictions separate.
Report all failures and abstentions; do not silently drop unsupported or unreadable cases.
Compute confidence intervals and clinically relevant subgroup/error analyses.
Do not promote evaluation evidence to runtime authority without a separate governed evidence-admission decision.
authority_note: This checkpoint establishes engineering readiness to begin validation. It is not evidence of clinical accuracy, safety, efficacy, or diagnostic validity.
